integrity: An analytic proof of the continuum identity is supplied, including both the universal estimate and a matching rank-one operator. Exact rational computations serve only as consistency checks. Originality is subject to residual risks from unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns real Lipschitz-free spaces over four-vertex weighted cycles with three unit edges and the remaining edge parameter in (0,1]. It does not treat general four-edge weights, complex scalars, or the case of a degenerate zero-length edge. The analytic result is supplemented by exact rational checks but these are not an independent proof or validation.
title: Exact numerical index along the short-edge four-cycle deformation
